 Word
 Meaning

 event

 process
 a series of actions that you take in order to achieve a result. (परिणाम प्राप्त करने के लिए आपके द्वारा की जाने वाली क्रियाओं की एक श्रृंखला)
 
 

 act
 to behave in a stated way. (बताए गए तरीके से व्यवहार करना)
 
 
 
 

 
• Let's look at the sentence: "The Twins Days Festival is a three-day **_________ ..."**
 
• We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is the Twins Days Festival is a three-day **festival or gathering of people**.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "event" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
